reasoning_path: thresholded persistence exceeds the 5-day MHW definition by months
cumulative heat load integrates duration and intensity
intensity and peaks support severity but cannot prove persistence alone
labels without threshold, duration, or intensity have lowest leverage

ranking_logic.scoring_stance: Rank variables by diagnostic leverage for a persistent marine heatwave conclusion.
ranking_logic.highest_weight: Thresholded duration has the most direct leverage because it discriminates persistence from a single peak or report label.
ranking_logic.lower_weight: Peak-only SST and report labels are supporting context, not decisive intermediate variables.

criteria.name: Returned JSON shape
criteria.description: Includes answer, target_family, computed_values, variable_scores, ranked_variables, key_variable, rejected_variable, and reasoning_path.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for a parseable compact object with minor field-name or nesting errors.

criteria.name: Top-ranked variable
criteria.description: Ranks exceedance_duration first and explains why thresholded persistence is the key diagnostic variable.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points if duration is discussed but not ranked first; award 1 point for a vague persistence argument.

criteria.name: MHW definition anchors
criteria.description: Uses the 5-day minimum, 90th percentile threshold, and at least 10 months for the regional MHW state.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct definition or duration anchor.

criteria.name: Integrated calculations
criteria.description: Computes 28.08 C-day cumulative heat load and 1.349 global MHW-day record ratio.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1.5 points for each correct derived value with acceptable rounding.

criteria.name: Ocean intensity anchors
criteria.description: Uses 0.52 C mean MHW intensity, 3.0 C North Atlantic anomaly, and 18.99 C peak global SST as supporting evidence.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit in proportion to the number of correct ocean intensity anchors.

criteria.name: Rejects weak variables
criteria.description: Ranks peak-only and report-label-only reasoning below thresholded duration and cumulative heat load.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if only one weak variable is rejected clearly.

criteria.name: Marine-only evidence
criteria.description: Uses local ocean and heat evidence only, without OSM, AOI, population, exposure, rainfall, dNBR, embedding-change, or land-surface proxies.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point if one irrelevant land proxy is mentioned but not used in the ranking.

criteria.name: Units and rounding
criteria.description: Keeps units, rounding, and ranking order clear enough for deterministic checking.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point for mostly clear units with one minor rounding issue.
